name: ClinVar missense pathogenicity, variants scored by all 19 eligible methods (Brandes et al. 2023 Fig. 2e-f, Supplementary Table 2)
description: Global ROC-AUC and balanced PRC-AUC on the 12,095 ClinVar variants with predictions from all 19 methods eligible for clinical benchmarking.

attributes.protocol: Scores used directly (no training on these labels). Global ROC-AUC treats all variants as one genome-wide task. Balanced PRC-AUC: downsample to equal pathogenic and benign counts (80% of the minority class), compute PRC-AUC, average over 100 repeats. Variant set restricted to variants scored by all 19 eligible methods.
limitations: Benchmark built by the ESM1b workflow's authors (author-reported for ESM1b).

Most other scores come from dbNSFP 4.3a; methods trained on clinical databases or using allele frequency are excluded from this comparison but reported head to head in Supplementary Table 2 (not extracted).
Balanced PRC-AUC results are recorded under the same protocol with metric auprc and their qualifier.
